tools.name: list-applications
tools.title: List Applications
tools.description: List the applications App Freezer currently knows about, with their paused/running status and live CPU and memory usage. Read-only: never pauses, resumes, or quits anything.

ai.instructions: Use List Applications to answer questions about which applications are currently paused or running, and their CPU/memory usage, as reported by App Freezer. This tool is read-only and never pauses, resumes, or quits an application; if the user wants to change an application's state, tell them to use the Pause or Resume App, Quit App, Force Quit App, or Resume All Apps commands instead.
